title: Pack Binary Document Layer Across All Apps
description:
Introduce a new binary document layer ("pack") used by every app to store the initial document and for export/import, while keeping the existing text DSL layer (debugging, LLMs) with guaranteed bidirectional dsl<->pack conversion. The op-log based VCS materialization (vcs::OpText, .ops files, replay) stays completely unchanged.

Full design is at /Users/ueli/.claude/plans/introduce-a-new-layer-valiant-diffie.md (already approved by the user in plan mode). Summary:

- New crate family under pack/ (pack_core, pack_format, pack_value, pack_io, pack_async, pack_http, pack_index, pack facade, pack_testkit, pack_cli) implementing a general-purpose, gigabyte-scale binary document container: superblock/header, footer-based root discovery, self-describing segment framing with 64-bit lengths, canonical encoding mode, CRC-32C + blake3 content hashing, unknown-field/segment preservation, chunked blobs, streaming write, deflate compression, three verification levels, corruption-hardened decode, and a testkit law suite.
- pack_value encodes/decodes dsl_schema's (RecordSpec, RecordValue) value model (stable u16 field ids) directly, so dsl text and pack bytes are two projections of the same RecordValue -- bidirectionality is structural, not just tested.
- vcs gains a new `DocumentPack` trait (mirroring the existing `DocumentDsl` trait) plus a `serde_json::Value` bridge impl, DocumentPackFiles, print_document_pack/parse_document_pack, FolderTextStorage/FolderSqliteStorage pack support, and a runtime DocumentCodec registry used to fix framework/sync's type-erased FolderEndpoint.
- dsl_derive's DslDocument derive macro is extended to also emit `impl ::vcs::DocumentPack`, so all ~49 existing document kinds across 33 plugins gain pack support purely by recompiling -- zero per-app codec code.
- framework/plugin, the WIT ABI, the wasmtime host, the browser jco bridge, the OS shell (export/import commands), and framework/sync all get pack-aware wiring.
- Every app (~24 family groupings covering 49 document kinds) gets: codec registration, new assert_dsl_pack_equivalence/assert_document_pack_round_trip test calls beside its existing DSL round-trip tests, and any remaining JSON example fixtures hand-converted to DSL text.

Execution is a 4-wave parallel-agent rollout (wave 0: pack crates in parallel; wave 1: single-agent critical-section integration into vcs/dsl_derive/framework/script.ts; wave 2: ~24 parallel per-app-family agents with zero file overlap; wave 3: single-agent verification sweep). See the plan file for the full file-by-file breakdown, byte-level container format spec, API signatures, and per-agent task templates.
summary:
Fixed a confirmed double-delivery bug in DocumentStore::pump/merge_remote_snapshot when a backbone is attached. Root cause: an edit's top-level `id` is not a stable cross-store identity — `ingest_envelope` (the `BackboneMessage::Operations` path) reconstructs a remote op's edit under its WIRE id (`envelope.operation_id`, derived from the op's `operation_meta`/`Operation::operation_id()`/edit-id fallback chain), which differs from the id that same op's edit carries on the store that authored it. `merge_remote_snapshot` (the structural-command Snapshot path — undo/redo/checkpoint/alternative/amend all send a full snapshot via `flush_outbound`) only deduped by that top-level id, so a snapshot re-broadcasting an edit this store already ingested via Operations (under the different wire id) read as "new" and got merged a second time. Harmless for idempotent patch-style ops (masked cad-program's passing `two_instances_converge_disjoint_edits_via_backbone` test), but a visible duplicate for insert-style ops (raster's `addLayer`, confirmed via `two_instances_converge_disjoint_layer_edits_via_backbone`: B ended up with layer-3 duplicated, 3 vs 2 layers).

Fix: extracted the id half of `operation_envelope_from_edit`'s per-op fallback chain into a new `protocol_causal::operation_ids_for_edit` (re-exported through the `protocol` facade), single source of truth for both envelope construction and dedup. `store::merge_remote_snapshot` now builds its known-edits index from both edits' top-level ids AND their derived per-op wire ids, skips a remote edit if all of its derived op ids are already known (fixes the observed ordering), and seeds `OpDag` with those same per-op ids (not just the top-level edit id) for both the fresh-store adopt path and the incremental-merge path, so a same-op `BackboneMessage::Operations` arriving in the opposite order is also caught via the dag's existing `AlreadyApplied` gate (fixes the mirror ordering).

Verified: raster's `two_instances_converge_disjoint_layer_edits_via_backbone` now passes (was failing `left: 3, right: 2`). Full store (78 tests), protocol_causal (27), protocol, store_sync, db_sync, db_conflict, db_security, protocol_testkit test suites all pass. cad-program's `two_instances_converge_disjoint_edits_via_backbone` (patch-style, previously-passing/bug-masked) still passes. Also updated the frozen PROTOCOL-BINARY-OP-LOG-LAYER contract doc's protocol_causal Bridge region and facade re-export list to document the new `operation_ids_for_edit` helper.

Unrelated to this fix: raster-program/cad-program have 4 pre-existing failing tests (icon-catalog "invalid catalog icon name" panics, a bundle-manifest sanity check, a utility-registry test) caused by concurrent in-progress work elsewhere in the repo, not touched here.
